### Phase 11: neutral-CfL anchors and direct finalist Store

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase11-cheap-navigation/1` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Remove work that cannot affect the Fast preset's returned pixels: keep the production hierarchical cover but use neutral CfL for both navigation anchors, then restore full CfL on the freshly optimized finalist. Verify finalist and correction sizes through their exact retained Store emission so the accepted path does not traverse Count and Store separately. Retain only if the exact ceiling, fallback behavior and perceptual corpus remain sound while fresh interleaved timing improves over Phase 10.
